nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs when LeadFlow Sales AI fails. Set this workflow as the "Error workflow" in the settings of the main workflow.

nodes.name: Configuración
nodes.notes: Paste the same Google Sheet ID as in the main workflow.

nodes.name: Construir fila de error
nodes.notes: Builds a bounded error row: failing node, short message, execution id. No request body, no stack trace.

nodes.name: Registrar ejecución fallida
nodes.notes: Appends the row to the errores tab.
